name: octowatch
description: Read-only OctoWatch DLP Cloud (octowatchdlp.com) MCP: risks, idle time, productivity, and employee monitoring. Runs locally; demo or your console login.

OCTOWATCH_API_BASE.title: API base URL
OCTOWATCH_API_BASE.description: Cloud API host (serverBase). Leave default for public cloud.

OCTOWATCH_EMAIL.title: Console email
OCTOWATCH_EMAIL.description: Operator email. Demo default works for try-out; use your least-privilege operator for a real tenant.

OCTOWATCH_PASSWORD.title: Console password
OCTOWATCH_PASSWORD.description: Operator password. Demo default is "demo". Never commit production passwords.
